blocks.text: Guided Ice Fishing Trips Detroit Lakes, MN
Join Baxstar Fishing Guide Service for a fully guided, Minnesota ice fishing experience on Detroit Lake and surrounding Becker County waters. All equipment included—just show up and fish in comfort!

Baxstar Fishing provides professional guided ice fishing trips for anglers of all experience levels. Whether you're a first-timer, a family looking for a winter adventure, or a seasoned angler after trophy walleye, crappie, or pike, we supply the gear, expertise, and the best local fishing locations.

🔥Heated portable shelters or wheel house

 

 
 🎣 Rods, reels, tackle, and bait

 

 
 🧊 Pre-drilled holes with clean ice setup

 

 
 📡 Garmin Livescope sonar technology

 

 
 🐟 Target crappie, bluegill, pike, walleye & bass

 

 
 ❄️ Transportation on-and-off the ice can be arranged

Whether you’re new to ice fishing or a seasoned angler looking for a dialed-in winter adventure, Baxstar offers guided trips designed around your goals and experience level.  All trips include heated shelter setups, holes drilled ahead of time, and expert instruction from a professional guide. 


 


4--8 hour trips start at $395.


​


Trips take place on Detroit Lake unless prior arrangements are made — contact us anytime if you’d like to fish a different lake.​​

Warm winter clothing & boots

 

 
 Snacks and drinks (optional)

 

 
 Fishing license (required for all anglers 16+)

 

 
 4 x 4 vehicle preferred


 
 
 Transportation can be arranged otherwise

 

 
 



​


We provide everything else!

All guided ice fishing trips include Garmin Livescope technology.  Track fish in real time, watch them react to your lure, and learn advanced techniques from your guide.​


​​



 
 Real-time fish tracking

 

 
 Helps new anglers learn faster

 

 
 Increases catch rates dramatically

 

 
 Keeps kids (and adults!) engaged for hours

Check your confirmation email after you book for more information.

 

 
 We will contact you the afternoon before the trip to discuss details and send you directions to the public access.

 

 
 You will meet us at the public access and follow us to the fish house.  If you need a ride, we can accommodate that.

 

 
 Your house will be warm and ready when you arrive.
